entry.title: Google's New Gemini 4 Neon Outperforms Claude Opus 5.5 on Several Benchmarks
entry.summary: Google's Gemini 4 model family continues its element-based naming convention, with Carbon, Hydrogen, Argon, and now, Neon.

entry.title: Google's latest AI model is faster, cheaper and smarter than its flagship predecessor from just weeks ago
entry.summary: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth model in seven weeks, which is nearly 2x faster than its sibling Carbon, outperforms it on most benchmarks and comes in at a significantly lower price. The article Google's latest AI model is faster, cheaper and smarter than its flagship predecessor from just weeks ago appeared first on The Decoder.

entry.title: Generalization of Text Line Segmentation for HTR in Historical Documents
entry.summary: In this paper we investigate the generalization capability of state-of-the-art object detection models (Hi-SAM, YOLO, and RT-DETR) for the automatic segmentation of text lines in historical documents. Generalization is needed because it is not practical for museums and archives to produce large amounts of labeled samples for each new collection. entry.title: Learning Grounded Reasoning from Human Gaze
